## Package

`caravel_qfn64` — ChipFoundry chipIgnite Caravel SoC in QFN-64 package. Declares the Caravel-intrinsic pin map that every chipIgnite user project shares: which Caravel io_in[] indices are reserved for management-SoC housekeeping, which are available to the user project, and the standard power and reset pin names. The user-GPIO-to-io_in translation is a fixed +5 offset (io_in[0..4] are housekeeping, user project sees io_in[5..37]). Physical QFN pin numbers are deferred — see 'pinout_source' below — and are resolved at PCBA emission time from the KiCad footprint library.

- Body: QFN-64 9x9mm 0.5mm pitch
- Pin count: 64
- User GPIOs: 33 (offset +5 from io_in[])
- Pinout source: **symbolic_only**

> This package library declares signal names and the user-GPIO-to-io_in offset, not physical QFN pin numbers. Physical pad placement is resolved from the KiCad footprint library at PCBA emission time. A future revision will add an authoritative qfn_pin field populated from the upstream Caravel packaging docs.
